title: Canine/Feline Serum or Plasma Deproteinization for Amino Acid Analysis
author: Amanda Blake
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.877hzrn

steps.title: Prepare 5 % SSA solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 5 g sulfosalicylic acid (≥99 % purity, Merck Millipore, Cat #S7422, CAS 5965‑83‑3) into a graduated cylinder, add 6.6 ± 0.1 mg L‑norleucine (Merck Millipore, Cat #N8513‑100 mg, CAS 327‑57‑1), fill to 100 mL with Biochrom lithium loading buffer, stir briefly on a magnetic stir plate until fully dissolved, and store the 5 % (w/v) SSA solution containing 500 µM L‑norleucine at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 100 mL with Biochrom lithium loading buffer.

steps.title: Aliquot serum or plasma
steps.instruction: Pipette 250 µL of canine or feline serum/plasma into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. If less sample is available, as little as 100 µL may be used; in that case add an equal volume of the SSA reagent (1:1 v/v).

steps.title: Add SSA reagent
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of the prepared 5 % SSA solution (containing 500 µM L‑norleucine) to the tube. For reduced sample volumes, add the same volume of SSA as the sample (e.g., 150 µL sample + 150 µL SSA).

steps.title: Vortex and incubate
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture on high speed for 5–10 seconds, then place the tube at 4 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet proteins
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10 000 rcf (≈10 000 × g) at 4 °C for 5 minutes. A white pellet with floating lipid debris and a clear supernatant should be observed.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to filter
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the clear supernatant to a centrifuge filter tube (750 µL non‑sterile micro‑centrifugal PVDF membrane, 0.2 µm pore size, Thermo Fisher, Cat #F2517‑5) without disturbing the pellet or lipid layer.

steps.title: Filter and store filtrate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter tube at 10 000 rcf, 4 °C for 5 minutes. Discard the filter, then store the filtrate at –80 °C until amino‑acid analysis. If the filter clogs, transfer the unfiltered liquid to a new filter and repeat centrifugation. Obtain at least 100 µL of filtrate (aim for ≥250 µL to allow for reruns).

substeps.instruction: If clogged, re‑filter using a fresh membrane.
